metadata.title: 115學年度第一學期八年級英語科第二次定期評量試題本
metadata.subject: English

sections.section_title: 一、 文意字彙與語法選擇 (第 1-5 題，每題 4 分，共 20 分)

questions.stem: Rita _____ her dogs three times a day. That's why they are getting too fat.
questions.explanation: 依後文『那就是為什麼牠們變太胖了』，前文應選『餵食 (feeds)』，故選 (A)。

questions.stem: It is difficult _____ Sam to wake up early on cold winter mornings.
questions.explanation: 句型為『It is + adj. + for sb. + to VR』，表示對某人而言做某事是困難的，故選 (A)。

questions.stem: Look at the floor plan below. Where is the milk placed to make shoppers walk more?

options.C: At the very back of the store.

questions.explanation: 根據超市內部平面地圖，牛奶等乳製品被放置在店鋪最深處 (Back Wall)，迫使顧客走遍全店，故選 (C)。

questions.stem: I thought the friendly girl was Kate, but it was actually her twin sister, Candy.
questions.explanation: 此處需要關係代名詞主格 who 引導關係子句修飾先行詞 the girl，故選 (C)。

questions.stem: Which of the following questions can best be answered by looking at the environmental data?

options.A: How many plastic bags did the students use before they started the reduction plan?
options.B: Why did the school decide to cancel all outdoor sports events during winter?
options.C: Who was the first teacher to introduce modern music into the rural elementary school?
options.D: What time will the morning express train arrive at the central railway station?

questions.explanation: 只有選項 (A) 的塑膠袋減量數據與環保議題直接相關，其餘皆為無關選項，故選 (A)。

sections.section_title: 二、 閱讀題組 (第 6-8 題，每題 10 分，共 30 分)

passages.title: SDGs in Action: Plastic Bag Reduction
passages.content: In our two-week environmental project, students tracked their daily habits. In the first week, an average student used 14 plastic bags. By the third week, after carrying eco-friendly reusable shopping bags, the number dropped down to 2 bags per week! Small everyday actions truly bring huge triumphs.

sub_questions.stem: What is the main topic of the reading above?

options.A: How students successfully reduced the use of plastic bags.
options.B: Why fast food restaurants charge extra money for cups.
options.C: The history of supermarket shelf design in Taiwan.
options.D: Ways to take care of rescue dogs during earthquakes.

sub_questions.explanation: 短文主旨描述學生在兩週減塑專案中成功減少塑膠袋使用量，故選 (A)。

sub_questions.stem: According to the bar chart, how many plastic bags did a student use in Week 3?
sub_questions.explanation: 依據統計長條圖，第三週每人平均塑膠袋使用量為 2 個，故選 (C)。

sub_questions.stem: What can we infer from the phrase 'Small everyday actions truly bring huge triumphs'?

options.A: Buying reusable bags is very difficult for students.
options.B: Individual minor efforts can make a big positive difference to nature.
options.C: Supermarkets should stop selling groceries completely.
options.D: Students should not participate in environmental projects.

sub_questions.explanation: 言外之意在於每個人日常生活的小小改變，累積起來能對大自然產生巨大正向改變，故選 (B)。

sections.section_title: 三、 依提示作答與引導式翻譯 (第 9-12 題，共 50 分)

questions.stem: Candy was my best friend. / I thought so. (請用『... that ...』合併兩句)
questions.answer: I thought that Candy was my best friend.
questions.explanation: 名詞子句當受詞，主要子句為 I thought，受詞子句為 that Candy was my best friend。

questions.stem: Walking into the wrong classroom really upset Lisa. (請用虛主詞『It ...』改寫句子)
questions.answer: It really upset Lisa to walk into the wrong classroom.
questions.explanation: 虛主詞 It 代替真主詞不定詞片語 to walk into the wrong classroom。

questions.stem: 顧客在店裡停留得越久，他們花得錢就越多。(請依中文字義翻譯成英文)
questions.answer: The longer customers stay in the store, the more money they spend.
questions.explanation: 運用雙重比較級句型：The + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V。

questions.stem: 對初學者而言，每天規律練習是很重要的。(請依中文字義翻譯成英文)
questions.answer: It is important for beginners to practice regularly every day.
questions.explanation: 運用虛主詞句型：It is + adj. + for sb. + to VR。
